scavenge.definition:
v. clean refuse from
v. feed on carrion or refuse
v. remove unwanted substances from
scavenge.translation:
vt. 打扫, 排除废气, 在...中找有用之物, 以...为食, 清除
vi. 清扫

scavenged.definition:
v clean refuse from
v collect discarded or refused material
v feed on carrion or refuse
v remove unwanted substances from
scavenged.translation: v. （动物）以（垃圾、腐肉）为食( scavenge的过去式和过去分词 ); 在（废弃物中）搜寻（食物、可用物品等）

scavenger.definition:
n. a chemical agent that is added to a chemical mixture to counteract the effects of impurities
n. any animal that feeds on refuse and other decaying organic matter
scavenger.translation:
n. (英)清道夫, 清扫工, 拾垃圾的人, 清除剂, 净化剂, 食腐动物, 黄色作家
[计] 清除器

scavenger enzymes.translation: [医] 清除酶, 过氧化氢酶

scavenger hunt.translation: 寻宝游戏（参加者必须找到各种物品）

scavenger-cell.translation: [医] 清除细胞, 游走细胞

scavengers.definition:
n. a chemical agent that is added to a chemical mixture to counteract the effects of impurities
n. someone who collects things that have been discarded by others
n. any animal that feeds on refuse and other decaying organic matter
scavengers.translation: n. 食腐动物；清道夫；[助剂] 清除剂；拾荒者

scavenges.definition:
v clean refuse from
v collect discarded or refused material
v feed on carrion or refuse
v remove unwanted substances from
scavenges.translation: v. （动物）以（垃圾、腐肉）为食( scavenge的第三人称单数 ); 在（废弃物中）搜寻（食物、可用物品等）

scavenging.definition:
v clean refuse from
v collect discarded or refused material
v feed on carrion or refuse
v remove unwanted substances from
scavenging.translation:
[化] 除气; 除气法; 清除的
[医] 清除

scavenging blower.translation: [机] 驱气鼓风机, 驱气泵

scavenging stroke.translation: [机] 驱气冲程, 驱气行程
